history.content: I have a wedding in Austin on Oct 10. What do I need to sort out this week?

Big one: book your flight and hotel now if you haven't, since it's under two weeks out and Austin prices climb fast. Also RSVP if you haven't confirmed yet.

Then this week:

Check the dress code on the invite and figure out what you're wearing (plus shoes you can dance in)

Any gift to buy or send, registry closes faster than you'd think

Check if you need to RSVP to any welcome dinner or rehearsal events

Look at transport from the airport, Austin rideshares get pricey during event weekends

Do you want help finding flights or a hotel? If you tell me where you're flying from and your budget, I can narrow it down.
